neighbours.label: the subword piece 'ag' inside a longer word (sph|ag|num, Sh|ag|reen), distinct from the + pole's ' sug'/' swe' (sugar, sweet)
fire: Gardeners line hanging baskets with sphagnum to hold water.
The book was bound in green shagreen leather.
The Mahagathbandhan alliance won most seats in the state.
Dried sphagnum is sold in bales at garden centres.
The case was covered in shagreen made from ray skin.
Bogs full of sphagnum store huge amounts of carbon.
Old pistol grips were often wrapped in shagreen.
Leaders of the Mahagathbandhan met to discuss the seat deal.
quiet: Gardeners line hanging baskets with coconut fibre to hold water.
The book was bound in soft brown calf leather.
The ruling alliance won most seats in the state.
Dried peat is sold in bales at garden centres.
The case was covered in leather made from cow hide.
Bogs full of moss store huge amounts of carbon.
Old pistol grips were often wrapped in leather.
Leaders of the opposition met to discuss the seat deal.
